lines: Other delivered libraries: 20, axios 1.20.0, dompurify 3.4.17, focus-trap 8.2.4, semver 7.8.6, @floating-ui/core 1.8.0, tabbable 6.5.1, and 14 more.

108 delivered files carry no source map, 3 files do. The bytes of the unmapped ones are charged only where the code shows its origin by itself: a copy of a file of the checkout, the glue of the bundler, code of the bundler and its plugins.
2 packages are imported by their root in src, each delivered in fewer than 8 modules, so a per-module import has nothing to leave out and the specifier decides no bytes here.
